summary: Established a coding-agent utility gate and a dated append-only audit trail for canonical knowledge changes.
rationale: Paper-level ingestion can add redundant or weakly actionable material that reduces retrieval precision and raises maintenance cost.
practical_impact: Future promotions must be novel, decision-relevant, actionable or testable, evidence-bounded, and accompanied by a dated change record.

summary: Added a narrow navigable-source tool and regression-test contract to the existing iterative retrieval pattern.
rationale: Stable source-local positions, explicit seen-result handling and separated mutation authority close an operational gap without duplicating established agentic RAG patterns or promoting vendor benchmarks.
practical_impact: Document-research and coding agents can now be tested for anchor-preserving navigation, repeat-result termination, tenant isolation and read-only retrieval authority.

summary: Improved coding-agent discoverability with a dedicated knowledge lane, technique-card cross-links, AGENTS.md consumption contract, retrieval eval cases, and a compile-generated technique index.
rationale: Coding-agent content was searchable but weakly connected through lanes, pattern-to-card links, and retrieval regression coverage compared with RAG and security topics.
practical_impact: Coding agents can now enter through a curated lane, resolve technique_id paths deterministically, and be regression-tested for harness, instruction, skill, and replay queries.

summary: Restricted the relaxed search fallback to selective terms and added a calibrated match confidence signal plus a read-first navigation and scope contract for agents.
rationale: The previous OR fallback matched filler tokens, so out-of-scope questions returned confident-looking noise with no signal that the topic is uncovered.
practical_impact: Out-of-scope queries now report low or none confidence with an advisory, the coverage floor is calibrated against the labelled retrieval pack, and agents are directed to navigate and load canonical sections before searching.
